_comment: Per-AMC SIF portfolio-disclosure sources. SIFs disclose holdings BI-MONTHLY (every alternate month, a SEBI rule); AMFI only links out to each AMC's own site, so holdings must be fetched per-AMC. Add an AMC = add one entry here + (if its file layout is new) one adapter in fetch_sif_portfolios.py. 'nav_sif' matches the 'sif' field in nav_data.json so disclosed funds map back to dashboard scheme codes.
